description: This file defines Swagger API documentation classes for CollectionSheet API in the Fineract project, including request and response schemas with nested classes and annotations.

classes.name: CollectionSheetApiResourceSwagger
classes.description: Contains nested classes defining request and response schemas for CollectionSheet API.

classes.name: PostCollectionSheetRequest
classes.description: Schema for posting collection sheet requests, including bulk repayment and disbursement info.

classes.name: PostCollectionSheetBulkRepaymentTransactions
classes.description: Represents individual bulk repayment transaction details.

classes.name: PostCollectionSheetResponse
classes.description: Schema for the response after posting collection sheet data, including change details.

classes.name: PostCollectionSheetChanges
classes.description: Details of changes made in the collection sheet, including transaction lists.
